entries.title: C14 public infrastructure REIT representative-route feasibility
entries.thesis: The fixed 508000 public infrastructure REIT zero-cost cash diagnostic is below the strict 5% hurdle in 2023, 2024 and 2025 and in all 40 available rolling five-year windows. It is not a personal net-after-cost return result and does not decide the full public-REIT universe.
catalysts: A documented-rights, point-in-time full public-REIT universe with price/NAV/distribution/corporate-action data.
A separately frozen cost, execution, account-route and independent all-endpoint study.
risks: Official day-price response has no verified adjustment basis.
Distribution, NAV, market price and personal cash receipt are distinct records.
No dated personal fee/tax, broker, custody, transfer, quote/depth, fill or settlement ledger.
One representative product cannot characterize the full REIT universe.

monitoring_triggers.name: c14_universe_and_net_ledger_gate
monitoring_triggers.condition: Open a new public-REIT hypothesis only after an entire eligible universe, point-in-time total-return inputs, personal cost/execution path and protocol are frozen before calculation.

invalidation_conditions: The fixed 508000 zero-cost cash diagnostic has 2023, 2024 and 2025 complete-year changes below 5%.
All 40 available rolling five-year zero-cost cash diagnostic endpoints are below 5%.
The diagnostic cannot be promoted to personal net-after-cost return while the required ledger is absent.

observations.note: The fixed 508000 zero-cost cash diagnostic is -30.67% in 2023, 3.11% in 2024 and 3.84% in 2025; all 40 available rolling five-year windows are below 5%. Required personal net-cost, execution and account inputs remain absent.

entries.title: C8 convertible-bond ETF fixed-allocation price proxy
entries.thesis: The fixed C8 convertible-bond ETF price proxy fails the strict 5% hurdle in 2022 and 2023 and at 123 of 187 rolling five-year endpoints. It remains a bounded proxy, not a total-return or personal execution result.
catalysts: A separately frozen product/event/total-return/execution study that treats the current proxy as a past hypothesis rather than a result.
risks: Public price input lacks complete event and total-return treatment.
Distribution, trading status, fee, tax, depth, fill and account conditions are unresolved.
The candidate was defined after product identities were observed.

monitoring_triggers.name: c8_new_protocol_gate
monitoring_triggers.condition: Re-open only under a new protocol that is frozen before data capture and has point-in-time total-return and execution inputs.

invalidation_conditions: The current price proxy has 2022 and 2023 complete-year changes below 5%.
123 of 187 rolling 1260-observation endpoints are below 5%.

observations.note: The fixed C8 price proxy has complete-year changes below 5% in 2022 and 2023, and 123 of 187 rolling 1260-observation endpoints below 5%. It is not total-return or personal execution evidence.

entries.title: C7 static multi-asset ETF core-satellite price diagnostic
entries.thesis: The fixed C7 ETF core-satellite market-price diagnostic has five of twelve complete calendar years and 1,428 of 1,952 rolling five-year endpoints below the strict 5% hurdle. It is not total return, personal execution or action evidence.
catalysts: A separately frozen, entitled point-in-time total-return, events, cost and execution data package.
A new protocol fixed before any result is viewed.
risks: The exchange public price endpoint has unresolved adjustment basis.
No distribution/event, bid/ask, depth, fee, tax, settlement, account or fill evidence.
The fixed composition is an exploratory research candidate, not an open-universe selection result.

monitoring_triggers.name: c7_formal_total_return_gate
monitoring_triggers.condition: Open a new C7-style hypothesis only when point-in-time total-return and execution inputs are retained with rights and frozen before calculation.

invalidation_conditions: The current market-price diagnostic contains five complete calendar years and 1,428 rolling-five-year endpoints below 5%.
A later total-return replay is a new hypothesis and cannot convert this diagnostic into a validated strategy.

observations.note: The fixed C7 official public market-price diagnostic has five of twelve complete calendar years and 1,428 of 1,952 rolling five-year endpoints below 5%. The result is not total return or personal execution evidence.

entries.title: C12 Treasury cash-futures basis feasibility
entries.thesis: The C12 Treasury cash-futures basis route documents actual T/TF contract observations and dated exchange mechanics, but lacks the complete matched cash, delivery, financing, cost, fill and personal-route evidence needed to test or claim the strict 5% hurdle.
catalysts: A licensed or authorized point-in-time T/TF, delivery-basket, conversion-factor and cash-bond data package.
Dated broker, custody, financing and paired-execution documentation followed by a separately frozen replay and maker-checker audit.
risks: An optimized-sampling Treasury ETF is not a deliverable bond and cannot be treated as a convergence lock.
Six retrospective actual-contract samples are not a five-year point-in-time population.
Two-leg liquidity, funding, margin, custody, delivery and personal account conditions remain unverified.

monitoring_triggers.name: c12_full_basis_ledger_gate
monitoring_triggers.condition: Re-open only after all actual-contract, deliverable-bond, financing, cost, execution and account inputs are retained with rights and frozen before calculation.
monitoring_triggers.source: C12 feasibility and R10 audit artifacts

invalidation_conditions: The current record cannot produce full calendar-year or rolling-five-year net-return endpoints after costs.
A later complete data package is a new research state and cannot convert the current route observation into a result.

observations.note: Independent raw-file review confirms actual T/TF source-route observations but not a complete point-in-time cash-futures basis ledger. Delivery basket, financing, costs, paired fills and personal route remain missing; no strict 5% test or action is admissible.

entries.title: C9 actual-contract commodity trend feasibility
entries.thesis: The C9 CU/AU/RU actual-contract trend rule has exchange-documented mechanics, but the retained evidence cannot calculate a complete cost-aware return history or establish personal operability; it therefore cannot support the strict 5% hurdle.
catalysts: A separately authorized and point-in-time full actual-contract data package with lifecycle, cost and execution inputs.
A fresh pre-frozen replay and independent endpoint audit after the data and account gates close.
risks: Six retrospective samples are not a complete contract population.
Continuous-contract substitution would invalidate the actual-contract selection and delivery controls.
Margin, limit, fee, liquidity, fill and individual account evidence is absent.

monitoring_triggers.name: c9_formal_replay_gate
monitoring_triggers.condition: Re-open only if all actual-contract lifecycle, pricing, rule, cost, execution and account inputs are retained with documented rights before any result is calculated.

invalidation_conditions: The current evidence has no full point-in-time actual-contract population or net execution ledger.
A later formal study is a distinct hypothesis and cannot recast the present record as a validated result.

observations.note: C9 has a detailed CU/AU/RU actual-contract rulebook, but only six retrospective official daily samples and no complete lifecycle, cost, fill or personal-access package. No strict 5% return test or action is admissible.

entries.title: C10 direct A-share quality and distribution diagnostic
entries.thesis: The ex-post four-name C10 direct-A-share gross-cash diagnostic fails the strict 5% calendar-year hurdle in 2022 and 2025. It is not PIT total return, a full-universe screen, an execution result, or personal action.
catalysts: A separate pre-frozen all-A-share PIT universe, total-return and execution study.
A future independent paper observation after data and market-access gates close.
risks: Post-observation name selection.
Unresolved raw-price adjustment basis and incomplete corporate-action accounting.
No full universe or all-market status history.
No quote, depth, fee, tax, fill, settlement or account evidence.

monitoring_triggers.name: c10_formal_data_gate
monitoring_triggers.condition: Only open a new direct-equity study when all-universe PIT status, corporate-action/total-return, execution and account inputs are hash-frozen before a selection result is viewed.

invalidation_conditions: The fixed four-name diagnostic has complete calendar years below 5%: 2022 and 2025.
A later formal all-universe study is a new hypothesis and cannot make the ex-post basket a validated rule.

observations.note: Independent raw-file arithmetic audit confirmed the four-name gross-cash diagnostic results: 2022 -0.15%, 2023 13.02%, 2024 26.15%, 2025 2.05%; 2022 and 2025 are below 5%.

entries.title: C13 SSE CSI 300 ETF covered-call feasibility
entries.thesis: The fixed 510300 covered-call rule has exchange-documented mechanics but lacks a point-in-time actual-contract and execution package, so it cannot support a strict 5% return claim or personal action.
catalysts: A new separately frozen actual-contract lifecycle, quote, settlement, cost and execution data package.
Independent confirmation of account and covered-reservation feasibility.
risks: Underlying ETF drawdown remains.
Corporate-action adjustment can alter multiplier and delivery reserve.
Bid/ask, depth, fee, tax, settlement and fill evidence is absent.
Account eligibility and broker process are not assumed.

monitoring_triggers.name: actual_option_package
monitoring_triggers.condition: Re-open only when the complete actual-contract, adjustment, quote, settlement, fee and execution package is hash-frozen before a replay protocol is viewed.

invalidation_conditions: The candidate cannot pass a strict net-return test while required actual-contract and execution inputs remain absent.
A later data package creates a new research state and cannot turn the current record into a result.

observations.note: The fixed 510300 covered-call rule has exchange-documented mechanics but lacks a point-in-time actual-contract and execution package, so it cannot support a strict 5% return claim or personal action.

entries.title: C11 manager-published market-neutral fund NAV proxy falsification
entries.thesis: The fixed 008856 official cumulative-NAV proxy fails the strict 5% complete-calendar-year and 1260-observation rolling hurdle. It is not a personal dealing result or action conclusion.
catalysts: A future, separately frozen product and execution study would be a new hypothesis, not a repair of this fixed proxy.
risks: Published NAV differs from holder dealing results.
Periodic dealing, channel and account state are not inferred.
Complete-year and rolling strict-hurdle failures.

monitoring_triggers.name: c11_source_or_rule_change
monitoring_triggers.condition: Only open a new candidate if a different product and a new pre-frozen protocol are independently reviewed.

invalidation_conditions: 2022, 2024 and 2025 complete-calendar-year proxy changes are below 5%.
All 204 available 1260-observation rolling endpoints are below 5%.

observations.note: The fixed 008856 official cumulative-NAV proxy fails the strict 5% complete-calendar-year and 1260-observation rolling hurdle. It is not a personal dealing result or action conclusion.

entries.title: H2 actual-contract futures public-route feasibility
entries.thesis: The current public/official H2 evidence cannot support an actual-contract, roll-aware domestic futures test or personal action; a continuous series cannot substitute for an actual-contract settlement ledger.
catalysts: Authorized actual-contract historical data and lifecycle delivery
risks: Missing actual-contract and point-in-time lifecycle history
Missing effective margin, limit and fee chronology
Missing broker fill/slippage and personal-account evidence

monitoring_triggers.name: actual_contract_data_delivery
monitoring_triggers.condition: Re-open only if actual contract, lifecycle, risk parameter, cost and fill data are hash-frozen before any rule is viewed.

invalidation_conditions: The current public-route predeclared-test hypothesis is invalidated by missing actual-contract, lifecycle, risk/cost/execution and account feasibility evidence.
A new authorized data package would create a new research state, not rewrite this finding.

observations.note: No actual-contract PIT lifecycle, effective risk/cost, fill/slippage or personal-account evidence is available. No roll-aware test or action may start.

entries.title: H1 direct A-share quality/value data feasibility
entries.thesis: A direct A-share quality/value family remains a distinct research candidate, but no historical PIT total-return-aware validation or individual action conclusion is currently supported.
catalysts: A formally licensed and hash-frozen cross-venue PIT data delivery
risks: Survivorship and venue bias without a daily all-venue universe
Financial statement revisions and corporate-action gaps
Unverified individual account execution feasibility

monitoring_triggers.condition: Only advance if each PIT, total-return, rights and account feasibility acceptance test passes.

A future forward observation is a new prospective study, not a retrospective repair.

entries.title: R5 public NAV proxy fixed-rule falsification
entries.thesis: The fixed R5 public accumulated-NAV absolute-momentum proxy must not be described as a stable 5% strategy. This is an exploratory negative proxy record only, not an investor-return or action conclusion.
risks: Retrospectively captured public accumulated NAV is not a point-in-time total-return ledger.
Displayed fund NAV is not an executable exchange-market price or individual-account result.
The five instruments are representative research inputs, not a decision universe.
Related public NAV fields were viewed before the protocol, so positive evidence is prohibited.

monitoring_triggers.name: independent_audit_refresh
monitoring_triggers.condition: Refresh audit only if an R5 control or derivation artifact changes.

invalidation_conditions: The strict R5 proxy test is invalidated because at least one complete calendar year and at least one rolling five-year endpoint are below 5%.
A different source, market-price ledger, or strategy family is a new hypothesis and cannot revive this fixed R5 proxy result.

observations.note: The fixed exploratory proxy has complete-year failures (2016, 2018, 2021, 2022, 2023) and rolling-five-year failures; it cannot be promoted as a stable 5% strategy.
